data.one_liner: One-shot Flutter QR and barcode scanner using native camera APIs.
data.what_it_does: Opens the native camera to scan a single QR code or barcode, returning the decoded string. Also provides functions to scan from photo pickers, paths, or bytes, and to generate barcode/QR images.
use_when: You need a quick one-shot camera scan that returns a string result
You want a simple scanner implementation without managing a camera widget preview
avoid_when: You need an embedded camera preview widget or continuous scanning
You need custom format filtering or complex overlay configurations
strengths: Supports both Android and iOS with native components
Built-in decoding fallback and retry logic for rotated images
weaknesses: Not a widget, so you cannot embed the camera preview inside your own UI layout
data.setup_notes: Android minSdk 21. iOS requires NSCameraUsageDescription and NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription in Info.plist.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick mobile_scanner if you need an embedded camera widget, continuous scanning, format filtering, or web/desktop support.

data.minimal_example:
import 'package:qrscan/qrscan.dart' as scanner;

String? code = await scanner.scan();
